findings.what: recordLeave does not take lockDoctor and createAppointment checks isOnLeave outside its transaction; a concurrent online booking can commit a booked appointment on a leave date that is never flagged rescheduling_required

acceptOffer claims the offer and creates the appointment in separate steps; on createAppointment failure the offer is voided and the slot is not re-offered to the next patient (a non-domain error also loses the patient's offer)
Concurrent cancellations can select the same first entry; the second insert hits waitlist_offers_pending_entry_uq and returns null, so that freed slot is offered to nobody
Waitlist entries for past dates stay 'waiting' forever; nothing cleans them up and only reads filter them out
